signature_moves: AI as a persistent full-width inline reading affordance — 'Summarize this conversation' at the top of every thread plus a sparkle toolbar action; the product thesis stated in one always-visible card
Saturated indigo selection card (#2558C9, white text) as the single Von-Restorff pop against muted panes
Triple-tone pane elevation (borderless tonal steps across sidebar/list/read)
Avatar/memoji-forward list rows — consumer-social warmth on pro mail chrome
defects: Inconsistent selection grammar — sidebar native neutral inset fill (#2C3235) vs message-list saturated indigo card (#2558C9); two selection languages in one window
Two-blue accent split — list-selection indigo #2558C9 vs filter/glyph azure #0093FF/#0090FA (near-miss hue deviation; accent should bind to one blue)
Line Length Fatigue (potential) — reading-pane body runs full-width with no ~65ch readable-content cap (composite crops line off-edge, real measure longer)
Pane tone-temperature drift — sidebar/list faint cool tint vs pure-neutral read pane #1E1E1E (minor)

aesthetic.direction: neo-grotesque product (dark neutral ramp + one electric accent) warmed toward consumer-social by avatar rows, rounded cards, and a saturated selection

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — saturated selection card makes the active thread the one different element (used well)
Fogg reduction — 'Summarize this conversation' lowers reading effort; AI as ability-lever
Jakob's Law — canonical three-pane mail layout matches trained expectations
Miller/Cowan chunking + progressive disclosure — account-sectioned sidebar; Labels/More/See More collapse depth
Hick's Law (mild tension) — deep sidebar + 5+ filter chips is high option-density, acceptable as an expert workspace
notes: Only a marketing composite was supplied (no gallery shots); the analysed surface is the app WINDOW inside it, cropped at the right edge by the composite. Render is ~1.67x (traffic-light dot 20px -> 12pt), not clean @2x, so all sizes are estimated with wide bands; flat fill hexes are clean measurements. Blue composite backdrop + wordmark are brand evidence, not digested here. Lineage is native (med) — native chrome (real traffic lights, glass-grouped toolbar, source list) with a custom iOS-leaning brand skin on the content panes; the saturated selection + avatar rows are house style, recorded as tells/defects, not as lineage disqualifiers. Icon.webp present but NOT digested (task is Workflow A / UI only). One app, one surface -> no promotions; single-app evidence.
